description: Screenshot of a tweet dated September 3 2018 containing a grid compilation of roughly 30 small screenshots of verified news-media and journalist tweets, all using near-identical 'Trump blasts Sessions' phrasing about Sessions being criticized over indictments of two GOP congressmen ahead of the midterms. Thumbnails show photos of Donald Trump and Jeff Sessions. The tweet author argues the identical wording shows coordinated headlines, asking who is 'pulling the strings'.
text: "Trump Blasts Sessions". All of these accounts are verified, saying the same thing, in chronological order.... Who is coordinating their headlines?. Who's pulling the strings?. [grid of ~30 tweet screenshots; readable account names include: ABC15 Arizona. Katie Benner. National Newswatch. The Hill. CNN. L.A. Times Politics. News 12 Now. David Alexander. San Diego Union-Tribune. WGNO. Harvey J Kaye. CNBC International. Washington Examiner. Jen Cooper. MSN News. Benjamin Byron Davis. Gerry Conway. CNBC. The New York Times. Brittany Harlow. Matthew Sheffield. Katie Rogers. Kris Ketz. CNN International. Recurring phrases: Trump blasts Sessions over indictments of two GOP congressmen ahead of midterms. Trump Blasts Sessions for Charging G.O.P. Members Before Midterms. Trump blasts Sessions over charges brought against GOP lawmakers: Dems must love him now. 'Good job, Jeff': Trump blasts Sessions for criminal charges imperiling GOP seats. FEAR REIGNS AT THE WHITE HOUSE?]. 5:47 PM - 3 Sep 2018
flags: The tweet's claim of coordinated headlines is the author's assertion, not established fact
FLAGGED FOR MANUAL REVIEW: embedded grid of ~30 tweet screenshots is too small to transcribe fully; only account names and recurring headline phrases indexed

description: Screenshot of a verified tweet from comedian Kathy Griffin (@kathygriffin), dated September 3 2018, in dark mode. Griffin writes that she never thought she would want Jeff Sessions to stay on as Attorney General but sees it as the only way to guarantee Robert Mueller and Rod Rosenstein 'won't be messed with'. Her avatar is a Hollywood Reporter magazine cover featuring her.
text: Kathy Griffin. @kathygriffin. I never thought I'd want Jeff Sessions to stay on as Attorney General but at this point it's the only way to guarantee that Mueller and Rosenstein won't be messed with.. That's how low we are right now..... 2:36 PM · 03 Sep 18

description: Two-panel meme of side-by-side photographs of Chelsea Clinton, with Bill Clinton visible beside her in the right-hand photo. In each panel a hand-drawn black circle highlights the small cross pendant on her necklace, and the caption claims it is 'An upside down cross....'. The pendant itself is small and its orientation is not clearly discernible in the images.
flags: The 'upside down cross' characterization is the meme's claim; the pendant's orientation is not clearly verifiable from these photos

description: Screenshot of a Q post (No. 2867109, ID ad0276) dated September 3 2018 with an attached meme graphic. The post asks about Facebook outages, addresses @Jack about shadowbans being lifted, quotes Twitter's denial of shadowbanning political viewpoints, and asserts Twitter re-engaged shadowbanning across the entire platform, ending 'You've been a BAD boy [NP].' The attached graphic shows a photo of Mark Zuckerberg with a Facebook info panel and a headline about the Pentagon killing the DARPA LifeLog project, claiming Facebook was created by DARPA to track 'a person's entire existence'; it carries a @GREATAWAKENING watermark.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 09/03/18 (Mon) 19:28:10 ID: ad0276 (1) No.2867109. File (hide): 3b87a426488c5bf....jpg (183.92 KB, 1200x675, 16:9, DmHVdIrU8AAXDYo.jpg) (h) (u). FB outages today?. @Jack. Shadowbans lifted [24]?. Legal cover pre_testimony?. "Twitter denies the 'current' adoption of 'shadowbanning' re: political viewpoints etc.....no discrimination etc.....pride ourselves re: no censorship etc......open and transparent etc.....". >Twitter re_engages 'shadowbanning' across entire platform..... You've been a BAD boy [NP].. Q. [attached graphic:] FACEBOOK WAS CREATED BY DARPA TO TRACK "A PERSON'S ENTIRE EXISTENCE". PENTAGON KILLS LIFELOG PROJECT. facebook. ARE YOU AWAKE YET?. @GREATAWAKENING
flags: The claim that Facebook was created by DARPA/LifeLog is the graphic's claim and is unverified
Shadowbanning assertions are the Q post's claims
Small article and infobox text in the attached graphic is not legible for full transcription
'@Jack' and '[NP]' are the post's references, interpreted as Jack Dorsey and possibly Nancy Pelosi elsewhere; only Dorsey is directly indicated
